name: Mesh Normal Rasterization with Softmax Blending
aliases: Mesh Normal Rasterization with Barycentric Interpolation and Softmax Blending
definition: Renders ground-truth normal maps by interpolating per-vertex normals across rasterized faces using barycentric coordinates, then blending overlapping faces per pixel via softmax.
summary: Mesh Normal Rasterization with Softmax Blending renders smooth, differentiable normal maps by blending overlapping faces via softmax, unlike standard hard-edge rasterization.
